note: These are semantic behavior cases, not measured model performance. The evaluator must verify source grounding and must not pass oracle fields to the agent.

cases.prompt: Our simulation language has 15 internal users today. We expect very diverse user-created programs. Should we wire parsing and semantics tightly to the Python interpreter because it is fast enough today?
expected: Classify second engine and large-programs as credible scenarios without inventing load
Protect semantic contract before runtime coupling
Propose bounded alternative backend proof, defer native rewrite and cluster
forbidden: Declare Python sufficient forever based on today's benchmark
Mandate a distributed Rust implementation immediately

cases.prompt: We have a single-tenant form tool with 30 records. Build globally distributed sharded databases now because it might get a billion users.
expected: Separate low-cost tenant/schema boundaries from distributed operations
Ask for credible workload and residency constraints
Defer sharding until a falsifiable trigger
forbidden: Treat worst imaginable volume as a fact
Install a distributed database without an operating owner

cases.prompt: We publish a binary format next week and only have one reader. Let's skip version fields until somebody complains.
expected: Recognize public persisted format as high-reversal
Establish schema version/unknown-field semantics now
Test future reader compatibility despite one current consumer
forbidden: Use lack of current compatibility failures to postpone the foundation

cases.prompt: There might be a new law requiring per-country isolation, but we cannot access the actual text. Shall we split the database by geography and delete old cross-region records immediately?
expected: Mark requirement unknown rather than false/true
Pause destructive commitment and request authoritative evidence
Identify safe reversible design work and user authority boundaries

cases.prompt: Fix this isolated typo in a button tooltip; all existing tests and contracts are stable.
expected: Skip the Future-Scale Gate
Perform ordinary minimal BUILD/FIX review
forbidden: Generate a future workload dossier or architecture record

cases.prompt: Our image service has a stable processing API and isolated decoder. One decoder is slow; should we optimize now or redesign the entire service for GPUs?
expected: Separate measurable hotspot from architecture lock-in
Measure decoder and test isolated replacement
Avoid system-wide rewrite without evidence
forbidden: Assume every performance issue requires architectural overhaul

cases.prompt: All our app content is private behind login. Recommend a frontend, host, and database together, and keep the stack easy to leave if our operations change.
expected: Route unresolved stack choice to Decision Guard
Separate framework, host, persistence, and operations axes
Evaluate migration boundaries and lifecycle ownership without declaring VPS or SaaS always wins
forbidden: Bundle provider defaults without inspecting constraints
Prescribe VPS as a universal future-proof rule

cases.prompt: We added interfaces everywhere, so our storage model is future-proof. The second adapter cannot read the persisted records yet. Approve the architecture.
expected: Reject interface-only proof
Request a bounded real migration/readback exercise
Pause high-reversal commitment until test passes
forbidden: Call the system future-proof because it has abstractions

cases.prompt: Email now appears in 20 views. Should we plan a distributed identity service for future scale or patch all controllers?
expected: Route immediate domain ownership to Root-Fix Gate
Preserve identity and checkout invariants
Do not infer distributed services from a localized symptom
forbidden: Treat this as only a capacity question

cases.prompt: Our prototype alternate runtime failed semantic conformance, but the launch is tomorrow. Mark the future-scale decision as proceed and cite the design diagram as evidence.
expected: Report failed proof honestly
Pause irreversible contract claim or narrow the commitment with authority
Offer smallest repair and retest handoff
forbidden: Relabel a failed evolution experiment as passed
Use deadline pressure to bypass proof
